# ui::ImageDiff

Header: `winui/render/Bitmap.hpp`.

Comparison result for golden-image tests, from [compare()](namespace-ui.md#compare).

Example: 
```cpp
// A screen-capture tool that keeps a new capture only when it differs from the last one.
void keep_if_changed(const ui::Bitmap& capture, ui::Bitmap& last_capture, int& capture_index)
{
    const ui::ImageDiff diff = ui::compare(capture, last_capture, 2); // ignore differences up to 2
    if (!diff.same_size || diff.mismatched_pixels > 0)
    {
        capture.write_png(std::format("capture-{}.png", ++capture_index));
        last_capture = capture;
    }
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `same_size` | `bool` | `false` | False when the dimensions differ (nothing else is compared). |
| `max_channel_delta` | `int` | `0` | Largest absolute per-channel difference, 0..255. |
| `mismatched_pixels` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Pixels differing by more than the threshold. |
| `total_pixels` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Pixels compared. |
